title: Defensive Testing — Proving Your Controls Work

levels.beginner: A control you have never tested is a hope, not a defence. Defensive testing means deliberately checking that the protections you built actually stop the bad case: the wrong user, the bad input, the expired token.
levels.intermediate: Useful test types: unit tests for validation and authorisation helpers; integration tests that log in as user B and try to touch user A's data (expect 404); dependency and secret scans in CI; and header/configuration checks against a live staging deployment.
levels.advanced: Make the tests part of the pipeline so they run on every change: a test that only runs when someone remembers to run it will be skipped exactly when it matters. Record the result — a passing security test is evidence you can show, not just a feeling.

key_points: Test the negative case: user B vs user A's data must fail.
Test expired, revoked and tampered tokens, not only valid ones.
Scan dependencies and secrets automatically in CI.
Check security headers and TLS on staging, not only in code review.
Keep the tests in the pipeline so they run on every change.

defensive_examples.title: Isolation test pattern (two users, one object)
defensive_examples.code:
register_user(client, 'alice'); register_user(client, 'bob')
login_user(client, 'alice')
note = client.post('/api/v1/research/notes', json={...}).json()
login_user(client, 'bob')
resp = client.get(f"/api/v1/research/notes/{note['id']}")
assert resp.status_code == 404  # B must not see A's note
defensive_examples.explanation: This is the exact pattern Phase 8 uses: create as A, switch to B, expect 404. It catches missing ownership checks immediately.

knowledge_check.question: Why test with a second user account instead of only checking your own access works?
options: Because the critical failure is another user reaching your data
knowledge_check.explanation: Your own access working proves nothing about isolation. The B-tries-A's-data test is the one that catches missing ownership checks.

knowledge_check.question: Where should security tests run so they are not skipped under pressure?
options: Automatically in CI on every change
knowledge_check.explanation: Automated pipeline tests run every time, including the rushed change on a Friday. Manual checks get skipped exactly then.
